sourceCountBoundary: The downloaded sparse CSV has 139827 rows; archive prose describes 99311 original records. These scopes are retained separately, not claimed equal or independent individual samples.
selection: Unique exact COL accepted name with same class and family; >=3 positive focal fields including >=2 life-history fields, each retaining same-name, same-family species-level cited sparse-table support plus final reference explanations. Final medians can still contain inherited data.
excludedFields: litters_or_clutches_per_y: sparse table uses litters_or_clutches_n_or_y; unit correspondence not adjudicated

longevity_y: final/sparse correspondence differs; not used in this batch

female_maturity_d.zh: 雌性成熟字段（源定义为首次受孕年龄）
female_maturity_d.en: female maturity field (defined by the source as age at first conception)

litter_or_clutch_size_n.en: offspring per litter or eggs per clutch

gestation_d.zh: 受孕或受精至出生的时间

weaning_d.zh: 转而依靠非母乳食物的年龄

maximum_longevity_y.en: longest lifespan record in the compilation

sourceInheritanceBoundary: Species/subspecies data-sharing algorithm remains part of the final summaries; raw same-name support does not remove all transferred contributions or establish current concept equivalence.
sourceInterpretation: Medians/interpolated medians; maximum_longevity_y is maximum, not median. No units or conditions silently converted.
underlyingLiteratureRead: Reference-list PDF extracted for traceability; first page visually inspected. Underlying publications not individually read.
sourceLicense: Official archive metadata states no copyright restrictions and requests citation; article and original input-publication rights are separate.
